name: Tempo
rationale: Tempo makes dictation feel like a well-tuned instrument: immediate, measured, and quietly capable. Cool chalk and deep petrol keep the app at home on a Mac, while a clear blue accent gives actions purpose. A tiny citrus detail adds personality without turning the interface into a gadget.
logoIdea: A lowercase t becomes a single turning stroke: a thought arrives, changes direction, and keeps moving into text. The broad crossbar and curved return create a compact silhouette that survives as a small monochrome menu-bar mark.

palette.name: Petrol
palette.role: Wordmark, primary text, and dark surfaces

names.name: Tempo
names.reason: A familiar, memorable word for a tool that keeps pace with thought. Strong enough for an app name and restrained enough for the menu bar.

names.name: Talo
names.reason: A compact invented-name direction with softer edges. More abstract, but visually distinctive and easy to set as a small wordmark.

watchout: Tempo is a common word; name, domain, and trademark availability have not been checked. Reserve citrus for small details.
